dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is automated code review and closeout validation, and its helper runs Codex review, optional fallback reviewers, git diff collection, and tests in service of that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The instructions keep review output advisory, require verification of findings, avoid pushing unless requested, and disclose that non-Codex reviewers receive a generated diff prompt.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact consists of a SKILL.md and a local helper script; there are no install hooks, background services, or automatic startup behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The helper defaults nested Codex review to full-access/yolo mode and may run repo test scripts or fallback reviewer CLIs, but these behaviors are documented and have opt-outs such as --no-yolo and --fallback-reviewer none.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It creates temporary prompt/output files and optionally writes an output file, but does not establish persistence or store sessions; several fallback reviewer invocations explicitly disable tools or session persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings: [SQP-2] expected: The privacy concern is relevant because diffs can contain sensitive code or secrets, but the artifact does disclose that fallback or second-opinion reviewers receive a generated diff prompt, so this is guidance rather than a Review-level issue.
llm.guidance: Before installing or using this skill, treat review diffs as sensitive: avoid running fallback or second-model review on proprietary or secret-bearing changes unless that sharing is allowed. For sensitive repositories, use Codex-only review, pass --fallback-reviewer none, and consider --no-yolo to avoid full-access nested review.
llm.summary: This is a disclosed code-review helper that can share diffs with review tools, so it is acceptable but should be used carefully on sensitive code.
